mainEntity.name: Do I need an accountant as a sole trader?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's not legally required, but a registered tax agent can lodge your return, maximise legitimate deductions, manage your BAS and PAYG, and advise on structuring. For most sole traders earning above the tax-free threshold, the cost is offset by better deductions and avoided penalties. The matching is free.

mainEntity.name: When should a sole trader become a company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common triggers are rising profits (where company tax rates save money), asset protection needs (industry liability), or a desire to reinvest profits at a lower tax rate. The matched accountant reviews your income, risk and goals and advises whether and when restructuring makes sense.

mainEntity.name: Does a sole trader need to lodge a BAS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if you're registered for GST (required above $75,000 turnover, voluntary below). If registered, you lodge BAS and report GST and PAYG. The matched accountant handles this — tell us your turnover and registration status in the questionnaire.

mainEntity.name: How much does a sole trader accountant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sole trader tax return typically costs $300–$600 depending on complexity. Ongoing BAS is usually $250–$400 per quarter. The matched accountant gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation. The matching service itself is free.

mainEntity.name: Can a sole trader accountant help with vehicle and tool deductions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched accountant advises on the logbook method for vehicle use, tool and equipment depreciation, and other trade-specific deductions — ensuring your claims are legitimate and substantiated so you maximise your return without inviting ATO scrutiny.

mainEntity.name: Can an accountant register my ABN and GST for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched accountant handles ABN and GST registration, PAYG registration where needed, and sets up your accounting software so your records are correct from day one — rather than untangling a mess at tax time.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched sole trader accountant contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your business.

mainEntity.name: Is matching free for sole traders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free for individuals and businesses, including sole traders. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm.
